rule.week_zero: business weekday offsets -1 through +3 from scheduled announcement, final day of two-day meeting
rule.holidays: count in phase; no fill without actual quote
rule.calendar_asof: At previous observed session close; apply latest dated update/cancellation. No emergency meeting retroactive insertion.
rule.execution: Phase for execution date known from prior calendar; buy or sell at actual next open. Start flat; first evaluation close baseline. No same-leader daily rebalance.
rule.missing_2007_anchor: Cash until first classified 2008 phase, disclosed.
rule.odd_control: Only weeks1,3,5 inside same finite phase, not tuned and not a candidate.

objective.primary: Full available-period excess Sharpe vs CashYieldCNY >=1.2
objective.comparison: Full CAGR >= native gold/Nasdaq control AND daily MDD <= native control; separate validity
objective.falsification: Report even and odd week strategy results, not a formal significance claim
objective.secondary: RF0 Sharpe, SPY passive, post-paper period and all crisis slices

differences_from_previous_research: Published 2014 alternating cycle risk premium; no condition on announcement-day return.
Not the 2026-09-07 one/two-day announcement window and shifted controls.
Actual SPY ETF opening quotes rather than Nasdaq price-index closing window.
limitations: Price-only SPY, omitted dividends, single Yahoo archive.
Next-open differs from paper close-to-close return intervals; do not reject original from adapted result.
Strictly prior FX both fills/marks; no USD wallet or conversion charges.
Scheduled-date notices currently hosted; first-release vintage not independently certified.
No 2007 cycle anchor; first classified 2008 phase only.
Native comparator uses different instruments/FX clock; diagnostic relative comparison only.
All history already exposed; no fresh holdout, no G0-G6 certification.
